info.name: Content Service - Project CRUD
info.description:
Sample requests/responses CRUD proyek (ContentDetailProject) pada content-service.

Semua endpoint admin, dilindungi JWT (Authorization: Bearer) + role super_admin/admin_pusat/admin_pustik.

Base URL local dev: http://localhost:4076/content-service/api

Endpoints:
1. GET    /project/side-menu            - daftar parent content tipe proyek
2. GET    /project/list/{contentId}     - list proyek per content (paginated)
3. POST   /project                      - buat proyek
4. GET    /project/{id}                 - detail proyek
5. PUT    /project/{id}                 - update proyek
6. DELETE /project/{id}                 - hapus proyek

response.name: 200 - Side menu berhasil
